languages.page.title: UI languages
languages.page.subtitle: Message catalogs are loaded from engine modules at startup. English in the base module is the canonical fallback.
languages.core.title: Core pack (base module)
languages.core.description: English is the only locale in the base module. Define every UI key in en.json first. Other languages must ship as separate modules (see below). Missing keys in any locale inherit English at runtime.

languages.modulePack.title: Adding a new language pack
languages.modulePack.intro: Register additional UI translations by shipping a module — not by editing the admin UI bundle.
languages.modulePack.step1: Create or extend a module under backend/modules/<name>/ with an i18n/ directory.
languages.modulePack.step2: Add JSON catalogs (e.g. i18n/es.json) and declare them in manifest.py.
languages.modulePack.step3: Restart the backend so the module registry loads catalogs. Locales appear here and in the user language picker.
languages.modulePack.overrides: Optional per-key overrides without redeploy: base.ui-translation (highest priority). Product copy still belongs in module i18n JSON files.

aiIntegration.apiKeyDescDefault: The key is sent over HTTPS, never echoed back, and stored encrypted at rest.
